## YTDownloader

A standalone app that downloads YouTube and other yt-dlp-supported sites' videos for offline viewing, behind a native UI. Paste a URL or share straight from the YouTube app, pick an exact resolution/format, and the file lands in `/var/mobile/Media/YTDownloader` for easy Filza access. First launch downloads the required runtime (~120MB) entirely in-app, with real progress shown (a bundled setuid-root helper handles the one privileged step) -- no SSH or terminal needed.

- **New in 1.39**: rebuilt on the latest codebase (shared with the TrollStore edition) -- everything below is now in the Sileo package too
- Best quality, saved as MP4 / WebM / MKV (VP9/AV1 + Opus merged losslessly), 4K/2160p included
- Audio-only as MP3 / M4A / Opus / FLAC / WAV; extract the audio of an already-downloaded video from the Library
- Channel / playlist **subscriptions**: new videos are queued automatically ("+" on the Subscriptions screen)
- Download queue with concurrent downloads, a charging-only mode, network policy (Wi-Fi only etc.), speed limit and file-name templates
- Section download (start/end), subtitles (embedded or SRT), SponsorBlock, thumbnail save
- Library with thumbnails, durations, multi-select, share/export, and download history
- Works with any yt-dlp-supported site; optional cookies for sites that need a login
- Share-sheet integration: send a video straight from YouTube's own Share button
- In-app update notice and a yt-dlp updater (the runtime is updated without reinstalling the app)
- English and Japanese localization
- aria2c and ffmpeg are bundled, so no `aria2` dependency; the runtime stays under `/usr/local` as before

Nothing to install separately -- on first launch the app detects the missing runtime and walks you through downloading and installing it in-app. Upgrading from 1.38 or earlier keeps your Library (`/var/mobile/Media/YTDownloader`) and the runtime already under `/usr/local`, so there is nothing to download again.

## YTDownloader

YouTubeなど、yt-dlp対応サイトの動画をオフライン視聴用にダウンロードする単体アプリです。URLを貼り付けるか、YouTubeアプリの共有ボタンから送るだけで、解像度・形式を選んで保存できます。保存先は `/var/mobile/Media/YTDownloader`(Filzaで簡単にアクセスできます)。初回起動時に必要なランタイム(約120MB)をアプリ内でダウンロードします(特権が必要な1か所は、同梱のsetuid-root補助ツールが行います)。SSHやターミナルは不要です。

- **1.39の新機能**: 最新のコード(TrollStore版と共通)で作り直しました。以下の機能がSileo版でも使えます
- 最高画質(4K/2160p含む)を MP4 / WebM / MKV で保存(VP9/AV1とOpusを再エンコードなしで結合)
- 音声のみは MP3 / M4A / Opus / FLAC / WAV から選べます。保存済みの動画から、ライブラリで音声を取り出すこともできます
- チャンネル・プレイリストの**購読**: 新着動画を自動でキューに追加(購読画面の「+」から追加)
- ダウンロードのキュー: 同時ダウンロード、充電中だけ進める設定、回線(Wi-Fiのみなど)、速度制限、ファイル名テンプレート
- 区間だけのダウンロード、字幕(埋め込み・SRT)、SponsorBlock、サムネイル保存
- ライブラリ: サムネイル・再生時間の表示、複数選択、共有・書き出し、ダウンロード履歴
- yt-dlp対応の各サイトで利用可能。ログインが必要なサイト向けにCookieの取り込みも用意
- 共有メニュー対応: YouTubeアプリの共有ボタンから直接送れます
- アプリ内の更新案内と、yt-dlpの更新機能(アプリを入れ直さずにランタイムを更新)
- 英語・日本語に対応
- aria2cとffmpegを同梱したので、`aria2` パッケージへの依存はなくなりました。ランタイムは、これまでどおり `/usr/local` に入ります
別途インストールは不要です。初回起動時にランタイム未導入を検知し、アプリ内でダウンロード・インストールまで案内します。1.38以前からの更新なら、ライブラリ(`/var/mobile/Media/YTDownloader`)も、`/usr/local` のランタイムも、そのまま使えるので、ダウンロードし直す必要はありません。

## 1.39

- Rebuilt on the latest codebase: MKV/WebM output, subscriptions, queue options, section download, subtitles, SponsorBlock, audio extraction, library improvements, in-app update notice
- aria2c and ffmpeg are now bundled (no `aria2` dependency); the runtime stays under `/usr/local`
- Library, settings and the existing runtime carry over from 1.38

---

## 1.39(日本語)

- 最新のコードで作り直しました: MKV/WebM、購読、キューの設定、区間ダウンロード、字幕、SponsorBlock、音声の取り出し、ライブラリの改善、アプリ内の更新案内
- aria2cとffmpegを同梱しました(`aria2` への依存はなくなります)。ランタイムは、これまでどおり `/usr/local` に入ります
- ライブラリ、設定、既存のランタイムは、1.38から引き継がれます

## 1.32 - 1.38
- Significantly faster downloads: added --concurrent-fragments 4 (parallelizes across a format's DASH fragments) and, now that this device's jailbreak apt repo turns out to already ship a prebuilt `aria2` package (no cross-compile needed, just a new Depends), aria2c as yt-dlp's external downloader too, splitting each fragment's own connection further. Confirmed on-device, same video/window: ~4.7MiB/s stock -> ~6.3-8.3MiB/s with concurrent-fragments -> ~9.9-10.8MiB/s combined with aria2c
- Fixed progress rows going permanently stuck at 0% on some downloads after the aria2c switch -- aria2c's own console readout has no configurable refresh interval, so a short/fast download could finish before it ever ticked once, with the summary also suppressed; added a file-size poll (reads the growing .part file directly off disk every 0.4s, independent of stdout) as the primary progress source, plus a safety net that forces rows to 100%/complete on a successful exit regardless of whether any progress line ever arrived
- Fixed the poll racing with real progress lines and occasionally snapping the percent backward -- both sources now only move the percent forward, never backward
- Added live download speed and ETA to the poll-derived progress (previously stuck at "--" for a poll-driven download even while percent/size were updating correctly)

## 1.26 - 1.31
- Fixed cancelling a download leaving late, already-buffered output from the just-killed process landing on the next queue item's progress rows (confirmed on-device: the audio row kept advancing after tapping cancel) via a generation counter that invalidates a cancelled process's callbacks
- Cancel now deliberately pauses the whole queue instead of silently auto-advancing to the next item, with a "キューを一時停止中 / ▶ 再開" row to continue when ready
- Added a "🗑 キューを全てキャンセル" row to stop the active download and clear every pending queue item at once, with a confirmation prompt
- The cancel button is now labeled ("✕ 中止", previously an unlabeled icon) and hides entirely once there's nothing running, instead of staying visible and silently doing nothing when tapped again
- "全てキャンセル" now resets the progress card to a clean idle screen instead of leaving the stopped download's stale thumbnail/percentages on screen

## 1.25
- Fixed re-downloading an already-downloaded video (via the ordinary paste-URL flow, not the playlist/queue path) leaving the progress card stuck with no video row and the audio row frozen at its idle placeholder while still reporting success -- yt-dlp skips the fetch entirely and prints a single "already been downloaded" line in that case, which the progress parser had nothing to classify. The same already-downloaded check the playlist/queue path already had is now applied here too, showing a clear alert instead

## 1.24
- Fixed the progress percentage briefly jumping backward on HLS/fragmented downloads: yt-dlp reports "%" as progress within the current fragment, which resets toward 0 every time it moves to the next fragment; now derives an overall percent from the (always-increasing) fragment index instead, so it can only go up

## 1.8 - 1.23
- Added a Settings row to pick the merge container (Auto-recommended/MP4/WebM/MKV) for the 最高画質/1080p/720p tiers, instead of always forcing MP4 -- YouTube's true best quality is usually VP9/AV1+Opus, which MP4 either fails to remux or produces a file this device can't actually play; Auto follows yt-dlp's own default (MP4 when compatible, MKV otherwise) and never changes which resolution/bitrate gets selected
- Added a resolution/quality badge on the active-download progress card, resolved to the real value (e.g. "1080p") once yt-dlp picks a format, not just the requested tier name
- Fixed three real on-device bugs found while making the video+audio progress rows actually track correctly: a --print flag for that badge was silently skipping every download (reported success, wrote nothing) unless --no-simulate was also passed, and separately suppressed every progress line (--no-quiet/--progress needed too); the audio stream was also being misidentified as a second video stream whenever it saved as .webm (YouTube's common case), since classification was extension-based instead of arrival-order-based
- Fixed the audio row being hidden entirely for the whole video-download phase instead of showing a "待機中" placeholder
- Playlist URLs now queue every video at once (capped at 200 so YouTube Mix/Radio playlists don't queue forever), with duplicate-download detection by YouTube video ID (not title, which can differ in Unicode escaping) for both playlist and single-video adds
- The queue section is now a collapsible accordion with a live remaining-count header, a free-space check before every queued download, and retry for failed queue items
- Download-progress notifications are now completion/failure only (no more frequent percentage-update spam)

## 1.7
- Extended the custom design language (typography, ticket-stub buttons) from the Download tab to every other screen: Settings, Library, quality/format pickers, video details, the runtime installer, and Welcome/Guide
- Found that a custom template-rendered icon crashes in EVERY UIKit context on this device, including tab bar/nav bar icons (not just UIImageView/UIButton as first thought) -- removed the two affected helper functions entirely and reverted those icons to SF Symbols, which are confirmed safe everywhere

## 1.6
- Swapped the home screen headline copy for something that matches the bolder new brand tone

## 1.5
- The Download tab now has a fully custom visual identity instead of the generic UIKit look: bundled typography (Space Grotesk headlines + JetBrains Mono technical text), a ticket-stub CTA button, a chevron-cut wordmark badge, a diagonal accent stripe, and chevron-cut thumbnails -- all custom-drawn shapes, no system chrome
- Found and fixed a real on-device crash hit while building this: a tintColor'd UIImageView/UIButton showing a template-rendered image (confirmed with both SF Symbols and a custom image) crashes via the same broken CoreUI/CoreImage path as the known keyboard-candidate-bar bug -- not keyboard-specific after all. Fixed by drawing icons directly via CAShapeLayer instead of UIImage wherever a tintColor is involved

## 1.4
- The in-app runtime installer now verifies the downloaded bundle's SHA256 (pinned in the app) before ever handing it to the setuid-root helper -- a corrupted or altered download now fails cleanly instead of being extracted as root
- Confirmed the app already works with any yt-dlp-supported site, not just YouTube (verified with a real Dailymotion download) -- updated the UI copy accordingly; cookie import stays YouTube/Google-only
- Fully localized to English (121 strings) alongside Japanese, selected automatically from the device/app language setting

## 1.3
- Security hardening for the setuid-root install helper (ytdrootinstall): it now verifies the direct parent process is literally YTDownloader.app's own binary (via the parent pid's resolved executable path) before doing anything, closing a gap where any process running as the same user could have invoked it directly for root-privileged writes under /usr/local. Also added a free-space check before extraction so a full volume fails cleanly instead of leaving a half-installed runtime
- Fixed a trap in the runtime-install flow: a failed install reached via the direct download-attempt path could leave the user stuck in a full-screen modal with only "再試行" and no way to back out. The error screen now always offers a way to dismiss

## 1.2
- Fixed a crash when tapping "URLを貼り付けて開始" (paste URL and start): the text-field alert it used to show triggers the on-screen keyboard, which crashes on this device (EXC_BAD_ACCESS inside CI::GLContext, rendering an icon for the Japanese input candidate bar -- a device-level CoreImage/CoreUI bug). The button now proceeds straight to quality selection when the clipboard already holds a URL, or shows a plain info alert (no keyboard) otherwise

## 1.1
- The required runtime bundle (self-built Python 3.13 + yt-dlp, Node 22, the bgutil PO-token server -- ~120MB) can now be downloaded and installed entirely in-app, with a real progress bar throughout. A bundled setuid-root helper (taking no arguments, trusting nothing from its caller) handles the one privileged step -- extracting the bundle under /usr/local -- since the app process itself has no write access there even with the no-sandbox entitlement
- Fixed the install-complete Welcome screen being presented on top of the still-visible "extracting" screen instead of replacing it, which could leave a stale-looking stuck screen reachable by closing the Welcome/guide screens

## 1.0
- Initial release: paste-URL and Share Extension download flows, real per-resolution/per-extension format picker, Library tab with native video playback and details
- Self-built CPython 3.13 + bgutil PO-token server for full-quality anonymous downloads
- "互換性優先" compatibility mode and per-row native-playability badges, backed by a real on-device AVFoundation check instead of a guessed extension list
- "他のアプリで開く" fallback in the Library tab for formats (WebM/VP9, MKV) this device's AVFoundation can't decode
- YouTube-thumbnail-accurate Library thumbnails via yt-dlp --write-thumbnail, instead of a blind ffmpeg frame-grab
- Fixed a cookies+tvhtml5 client conflict that silently broke every download once YouTube cookies were imported
- Fixed a ~1.5s main-thread block on PO-token server cold start that could interfere with the system's own app-switch animations
- Reworked the Share Extension's handoff to the containing app to use the public responder-chain UIApplication openURL: API, with transition-aware timing, after confirming the host app (e.g. YouTube) could otherwise be left with a stuck, untappable window on return
- Delete confirmation in the Library tab, download-progress percentage to one decimal place, BulletinRelay download-complete/failed notifications
